contract.name: 2026 – 2027 DMC contract rate sheet (update)
contract.tax_note: All rates are inclusive of taxes and service charge and non-commissionable; new taxes & levies implemented by the government will be borne by the tour operator or travel agent
contract.child_policy_text: Child Supplementary without extra Bed: 0-5 yrs. - FOC. 05-12 yrs. sharing parent's: BB US$ 15, HB US$ 20, FB US$ 25. Extra bed supplement US$ 10. Compulsory supplementary child supplement (05 yrs - 12 yrs): 50% of the 24th / 31st December rate.
contract.guide_policy_text: Guide Policy: guide room rate BB US$ 50, HB US$ 55, FB US$ 60. Tour guide will be accommodated in the hotel premises on availability basis; if the hotel is fully booked alternative accommodation will be arranged. For groups: guide or tour leader will be charged US$ 55.
contract.foc_policy_text: For groups: every 16th paying pax one pax FOC. For group bookings (10 rooms and above), reduction of US$ 5 from the above rate.
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellation & No show policy: no show or same day cancellation will be charged 100% on the basis booked. Cancellation 21 days prior to arrival - no cancellation charges. Cancellation 14 days prior to arrival - 50% will be charged on the basis booked. Cancellation 07 days prior to arrival - 100% will be charged on the basis booked.
contract.payment_text: Payment Policy: non-credit agents - full payment should be settled prior to the clients' arrival to facilitate a smooth check-out process. Cheques should be banked before 03 working days before the departure date.
contract.terms_text: All rates are inclusive of taxes, service charge and non-commissionable. The above rates are confidential and prohibited to publish on any social media or OTA with any other organization. New taxes & levy's implemented by the government, resulting in additional cost, will have to be borne by the Tour Operator or Travel Agent. Reservations: reservations@elephantreach.com, +94 477 388 008 / +94 772 075 712; Mr. Hasitha Heshan (Reservations Executive) +94 761 617 153.
contract.notes: One sheet with two rate tables, "Summer 2026" (01st May 2026 - 30th October 2026) and "Winter 2026/2027" (01st November 2026 - 30th April 2027), under a single set of conditions → one plan with two seasons. 31 October 2026 falls between the two tables and is NOT priced. Sheet dated 03rd Feb of 2026. The columns are SGL / DBL / TPL / FAMILY, per room per night; the FAMILY column is entered as the quad (4-person) price — the sheet does not say whether "FAMILY" is a fourth person in the room or a family-room category; confirm with the hotel. THE RATE TABLE PRINTS NO ROOM CATEGORY: the priced category is entered as "Standard Room"; the only category named on the sheet is the Chalet (+US$ 10 per room per night, printed under both tables). Peak-period supplement US$ 10 per room per night: 10th July to 15th August 2026 (summer) and 15th December 2026 to 20th January 2027 (winter). Group notes: every 16th paying pax one pax FOC; guide or tour leader charged US$ 55; group bookings of 10 rooms and above get a US$ 5 reduction from the above rate. Meal charges breakfast US$ 10, lunch US$ 12, dinner US$ 15; extra bed supplement US$ 10. The child bands overlap on the sheet ("0-5 yrs. - FOC" and "05-12 yrs."); entered as 0–4.99 free and 5–11.99 charged. The sheet's cancellation steps are 21 / 14 / 07 days, so 20 to 15 days before arrival is not covered by any printed band. Rates are confidential and prohibited from publication on social media or OTAs; new taxes and levies implemented by the government will be borne by the tour operator or travel agent.
